_comment: Shared color palette for all SAR-DDC notebooks. Based on Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe palette. Load with: import json; C = json.load(open(ROOT_DIR / 'configs' / 'plots_colors.json'))

_palette_reference.note: Okabe & Ito (2002), colorblind-safe, print-friendly. See https://jfly.uni-koeln.de/color/

platforms._note: Used in any figure comparing FPGA / GPU / CPU platforms. fpga=green, gpu=blue, cpu=orange — Okabe-Ito base colours.

fpga_power_groups._note: Used in §8a stacked FPGA power composition. PL=darkest, PS=mid, MGT+peripherals=pale. TBP idle line is orange/red to pop.

gpu_power_domains._note: Used in §8b GPU+CPU RAPL stacked bars. Mirrors platform colors so readers can connect the two figures.

nn_vs_cpu_domain._note: Used in NN-vs-CPU latency split figures (5b). Maps directly to gpu_dynamic / cpu_dynamic from platforms.

latency_steps._note: Used in §5 per-step stacked horizontal bars. NN subgraphs: dark→pale blue. CPU entropy: red→orange. CPU data-ops: grey.

architectures._note: Used in cross-model comparison figures. ResSHyp=green, SHyp=yellow-orange, ResFP=blue, FP=mauve — all Okabe-Ito.

activations._note: Used in RD-curve ablation figures. relu=green (Okabe), gdn=mauve (Okabe).

output_padding._note: Used in RD-curve ablation figures. Matches GPU/CPU platform colors — easy visual association.

metrics._note: Used in compare_gpu_fpga metric-per-line figures (if kept). Three visually distinct Okabe-Ito hues.

compare_gpu_fpga._note: Used in compare_gpu_fpga quality-delta figures. Same as platforms.gpu_dynamic / fpga_dynamic.
